description: MARKETPLACE offers from other users. If the user has not said whether they already arranged this trade with a specific person, ask first: "Have you already arranged this trade with a specific person, or should I look for offers from other users on the iEscrow marketplace?" With a counterparty of their own these offers are not what they need: a private trade with that person is opened from their iEscrow account. Best live offers on the iEscrow P2P marketplace for buying or selling crypto with fiat money, for the given crypto amount: price with the maker's margin, what the user would pay or receive all-in (platform fee included), whether it is instant and the accepted payment methods. No account needed to look. In every trade the crypto is locked in escrow BEFORE the fiat is paid, and released when the seller confirms the payment arrived. Taking an offer needs an iEscrow account: on the web at the marketplace, or with the agent connected to the full server.

crypto.description: Crypto symbol, e.g. USDT, BTC, ETH

fiat.description: Fiat ISO code, e.g. ARS, USD, BRL, EUR

payment_method.description: Optional payment method name to filter (e.g. 'Mercado Pago', 'PIX')

side.description: buy = the user pays fiat and receives crypto; sell = the user delivers crypto and receives fiat

name: get_quote
title: Live offers to buy or sell crypto with fiat
